products.identity_scope: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum; 150 ml research target

fields.ingredients: The official manufacturer page lists the peptide ingredients Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Copper Tripeptide-1, sh-Polypeptide-121, Dipeptide Diaminobutyroyl Benzylamide Diacetate, Oligopeptide-68 and Palmitoyl Tripeptide-8, and also highlights niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, N-acetylglucosamine and allantoin. fields.known_use_cases: Manufacturer positioning: skin conditioning/booster use with moisture, texture and radiance claims. These are cosmetic positioning statements, not a validated treatment indication.
fields.manufacturer_claims: The manufacturer reports +162.5% deep moisture, +76.4% texture, +40.1% clarity, +24.5% radiance and +22.2% density based on 20 subjects at Dermacosmetic Skin Science Laboratory Co., Ltd, 2023-09-18 to 2023-10-31. Full protocol, comparator, instruments, analysis and independent replication are not available in the reviewed public page; treat all figures as manufacturer-reported only.

ingredient_roles.notes: Analyst role mapping from source-disclosed ingredients and product positioning only; not proof of finished-serum efficacy or exact formula presence in the physical unit.

products.identity_scope: Neutrogena Clear & Defend 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash; 200 ml

fields.ingredients: UK manufacturer-page INCI snapshot: Aqua, Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine, Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate, Glycerin, Salicylic Acid, Sodium Hydrolyzed Potato Starch Dodecenylsuccinate, C12-15 Alkyl Lactate, Panthenol, Cocamidopropyl PG-Dimonium Chloride Phosphate, Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate, PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate, Sodium Chloride, Disodium EDTA, Citric Acid, Sodium Hydroxide, Tocopherol, Benzalkonium Chloride, Parfum. Manufacturer warns product/ingredients may change; physical package label remains authoritative.
fields.usage_instructions: UK source page directions: wet face, massage gently, avoid eyes and mouth, rinse; page mentions twice-daily use. These are source-page instructions only and must not replace the physical package directions for the unconfirmed target unit.
fields.manufacturer_claims: The UK manufacturer page declares 2% salicylic acid and reports 97% noticed fewer new spots in four weeks, based on clinical grading in 34 subjects. Full protocol, control and absolute change are not disclosed in the reviewed page. This is not a 97% acne cure rate and is not proof that the physical target unit is UK-market.

ingredient_roles.notes: CORE surfactant system means cleansing function, not acne efficacy. Parfum is a context-sensitive review flag, not a contraindication.

identity_limits: UK is the research source market only; physical target market and formula match UNKNOWN
Package INCI and warnings not verified

products.identity_scope: Anua Azelaic Acid 10% + Hyaluron Redness Soothing Serum; 30 ml

fields.ingredients: Official US serum-page ingredient declaration includes Azelaic Acid, Panthenol, Betaine Salicylate, Glycerin, Allantoin, Niacinamide, Centella-related ingredients, Sodium Hyaluronate, Squalane, Zinc PCA and Ceramide NP. This is a partial source-bound ingredient summary, not a complete verbatim INCI; the full package INCI remains UNKNOWN until matched to a physical label.
fields.claimed_benefits: A separate Anua routine/claim page reports that 90% of participants agreed the appearance of red troubled spots improved, attributed to a 2026 Anua US clinical study. Public methodology, sample details, comparator, validated endpoint and statistical report are not disclosed. Do not transfer evidence from the separate Anua azelaic-acid pads to this serum.
fields.usage_instructions: Manufacturer advises gradual introduction, beginning 1–2 times weekly and increasing as tolerated (up to twice daily per the source-page routine guidance), with daytime SPF use. Physical package directions remain authoritative.
fields.manufacturer_claims: The manufacturer declares 10% azelaic acid for this serum and labels testing as non-comedogenic/low-irritation. The public page does not disclose complete methodology for those test labels. Do not infer clinical treatment of acne, rosacea, PIH or persistent redness from ingredient presence or these labels.

ingredient_roles.notes: Role mapping is a cautious ingredient/function interpretation, not finished-product clinical efficacy. Existing conflicting evidence rows require review and reclassification before any accepted knowledge rebuild.

claimed_benefits.notes: Separate official routine-page manufacturer result. Kept in a distinct ProductKnowledge domain from the product-page 10%/tolerability claims to avoid merging unlike assertions into one field. Protocol remains undisclosed.

identity_limits: US official source is a source scope only; physical package market/formula match UNKNOWN
Keep this serum separate from Anua Azelaic 10 Hyaluron pads
